compatibility.externalUpmHost: a Framework-external controlled UPM client with live single-package upgrade and Resolve capabilities

actionAdapters.entry: external UPM host live capability list and package-management Schema (never nova_project_action)
actionAdapters.when: 升级前确认 Provider 已连接、具备单包 direct dependency 升级能力，并由包外宿主冻结或执行唯一 Framework 版本变更时

actionAdapters.entry: Packages/manifest.json + Packages/packages-lock.json + configured scoped registries + resolved Framework package/package.json
actionAdapters.when: 升级前后只读冻结或核验 current/target Framework direct entry、版本、来源和可解析依赖闭包；registry 凭据不得输出
新版本 Resolve、编译和自动投影稳定后，以新解析 catalog.json 的实际 Skill 数量核验 .agents/skills 受管状态，不手工 sync 或 reconcile

actionAdapters.entry: MCP tools/list -> nova_project_action presence -> read-only describe
actionAdapters.when: 重新连接同一消费工程后确认Tool可见并执行只读describe，不用它升级自身

actionAdapters.entry: Unity Editor menu Nova/Check and Setup AI Toolchain -> completed Nova AI toolchain Console report
actionAdapters.when: 新版本包含该入口且升级、Resolve和编译稳定后，自动安装缺失主机工具、插件和Pipeline，绑定本项目并复核；失败自动重试，菜单返回不等于完成，不要求项目组补装

allow: the confirmed external UPM host change to the single direct com.solotopia.nova.framework manifest entry, retaining the frozen configured registry source
Packages/packages-lock.json and resolved dependency closure updates produced only by Unity Package Manager Resolve after that confirmed change
Library/Nova/ImportantUpdates/<local-user-hash>/State.json automatic upgrade-scope bookkeeping and explicit human acknowledgement; never edited directly by the Agent
Framework 安装升级后固定自动流程安装缺失的 Unity CLI、Codex CLI、官方 Unity 插件及本项目 com.unity.pipeline；保留现有可用版本和其他包依赖
默认 Provider 自动准备本机 MCP 服务，保留其他项目有效服务和宿主配置，仅补齐当前项目专用 Codex MCP 绑定
Library/Nova/AgentToolchain/ 下本轮有界安装下载与失败恢复状态；临时脚本完成、失败或取消后清理
deny: nova_project_action, Framework C# AgentAction, arbitrary C#, reflection, execute_code or menu simulation for Framework self-upgrade
manual Packages/manifest.json or Packages/packages-lock.json edits, Git/file/local source, registry switch, downgrade or batch package upgrade
direct changes to Packages/com.solotopia.nova.framework/**, Library/PackageCache/**, package cache or Library cleanup
ConfigMaster, ConfigRuntimeSO, business Config fields, SDK/Kit setup, Sample, Scene, Prefab, Bundle or Player changes
automatic replay of Framework upgrade, rollback, dependency substitution, Git commit/push, UPM publish, external deployment or credential output
automatic Important acknowledgement, UI confirmation simulation, reflection or direct edits to local acknowledgement markers

requiredFor: the exact current Framework version/source and one latest or explicit higher target version/source
the external UPM host's exact direct-dependency diff, target metadata, registry identity and reachable dependency closure
manifest change, Unity Resolve and the expected domain reload or MCP connection interruption
any changed project root, current/target version, registry, host Schema, default Provider dependency, MCP Adapter closure or package graph
cache cleanup, rollback, source switch, credential use, Git commit/push, publish or external deployment
confirmation.rule: 确认只绑定当前 direct Framework entry、同源目标、外部宿主 Schema、registry 可达性和目标 Nova MCP 默认 Adapter 闭包。任何 manifest、lock、registry、目标元数据、Provider 依赖或 Editor domain 漂移都会使旧确认失效；断线或 reload 后只做恢复核验，绝不自动重放升级。 Framework 升级提交只执行一次；其后固定工具链自动安装、绑定和失败重试属于安装升级流程，无需项目组手动补齐，不能借此重复升级 Framework。

evidence: 升级前冻结的 current direct manifest entry、lock version/source、脱敏 registry identity、目标 metadata 和外部 UPM host capability
用户对唯一同源目标及其外部 UPM diff 的明确确认，以及 host 提供的提交 receipt（如有）
Resolve 与 domain reload 稳定后的 direct manifest、packages-lock 和 resolved Framework package 精确版本/来源，以及 Unity 编译结果
目标 Framework 的 catalog.json 实际 Skill 数量和 nova_skills.py doctor 对 .agents/skills 的 clean 结果；数量不硬编码
同一项目重连后 MCP tools/list 中 nova_project_action 的可见性，及缺失时未使用它或任意 C# 绕过的事实
未执行 Config、缓存清理、回滚、Git、发布、外部部署或凭据输出的边界说明
升级后的 CHANGELOG Important 按包分组、包内按完整 SemVer 从新到旧展示，需用户亲自阅读确认；Agent 不得自动确认或改写本地标记；安装成功与人工阅读状态分别报告。
自动安装和绑定逐项取得实际证据：官方插件installed/enabled、Unity CLI版本与当前Editor连接、两个MCP包闭包及服务、全部Skills；外部聊天工具列表另行现场核验，缺项或超时保持partial，不把缓存或菜单返回当作完成
